raw_text: Regarding the viral 'stealth drone over Ladakh' image: This is a Midjourney v6 creation submitted to our Digital Futures Art Contest last month by artist @cloudscaperender. The prompt was 'futuristic stealth drone flying over Himalayan mountains, photorealistic.' The piece placed 3rd in the Military Sci-Fi category. It is NOT a real photograph. Full contest gallery link in bio.
clean_text: AI Art Contest Official confirms viral stealth drone image is a Midjourney v6 art contest entry. Created with prompt about futuristic drone over Himalayas. Not a real photograph.
